description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in, and a verified referrer account. Reports a referral request to the techjobs.vn team (spam, inappropriate, fake profile, other) and removes it from the user's inbox; with block, the candidate can no longer choose the user. The candidate is not told. Only for requests list_referrer_requests shows; ask the user to confirm first.

block.description: true = the candidate no longer sees the user's referrer card, and their other open requests to the user go away.

note.description: Optional note for the techjobs.vn team.

name: report_referral_request
title: Report a referral request
